Act as though you were trying out for the role of a positive, cheerful, happy, and likable person. Walk, talk, and act as if you were already that person. Treat everyone you meet as though you had just won an award for being the very best person in your industry or as though you had just won the lottery. You will be amazed at how much better you feel about yourself after just a few minutes of _________________. pretending competing purchasing complaining apologizing

Life is a balancing act, and so is our sense of morality. Research suggests that when we view ourselves as morally deficient in one part of our lives, we search for moral actions that will balance out the scale. Maybe you know you should be recycling but just never get around to gathering up your glass, paper, and plastics in time for the recycling truck. One day you happen to be walking through a hardware store and notice a rack of energy-efficient light bulbs, and you instantly decide to buy twenty of them and change out every bulb in your house. The moral deficiency (not recycling) is, in your view, balanced by a moral action (installing energy-efficient bulbs). The problem is that the seesaw can also tip the other way: If we believe we are doing enough, morally speaking, then there's little reason to do more. The scale ______________________. is already level demands sacrifice is energy-efficient cannot be measured will read the true weight

Undergraduate tutorials all over the country each week are full of students, many of whom have great ideas, but who feel hesitant about speaking out or including them in essays. Working at degree level is all about reading, understanding and forming educated opinions based upon what you have read, but it is also, at its best, about having your own viewpoint. det.korean: 기술은 식품의 감각 특성을 마음대로 조작하는 것을 가능하게 했다. 이로써 식품의 맛있음이 영양적 가치와 완전히 분리됐다. 현재 기술은 에너지 소비에 있어 잘 알려진 위험을 초래한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① preserve(보존하다)는 manipulate(조작하다)의 반의어로 기술이 식품을 '조작'하는 맥락과 모순
✅ ② manipulate — nutritional — consumption: 원문 그대로. 기술이 감각을 조작하고, 영양 가치와 분리되며, 에너지 소비에 위험을 만든다
❌ ③ harmful(해로운)은 nutritional(영양의)을 대체할 수 없음. 원문은 'nutritional worth(영양적 가치)'로 고정
❌ ④ generation(생성)은 energy와 결합 가능한 오답 유인어. 원문의 'energy consumption(에너지 소비)'과 다름
det.tip: manipulate sensory properties(감각 특성을 조작하다) — energy consumption(에너지 소비): 두 표현 모두 원문의 핵심 표현입니다.
